name: PEN²

description: Independently ImageGen-generated, unofficial fan art of Pen Pen from Neon Genesis Evangelion, with Pillow/NumPy alignment and alpha cleanup. The v2 atlas includes nine animation states and 16 gaze directions; no official pixels were directly reused.
variant_note: BusanGukbap's independently ImageGen-generated chibi interpretation of Pen Pen, with Pillow/NumPy alignment and alpha cleanup.
